title: Harden cache refresh and path handling
body:
## Problem Statement
Cache refreshes in `src/cache-store.mjs` can interleave: two workers read the same entry, both persist, and the last writer silently discards the other update. Cache keys are also joined directly onto the cache root path, so a key containing `..` can escape the cache directory.

## Solution
- Serialize refresh operations through a per-key queue so concurrent refreshes cannot lose updates.
- Validate cache keys before joining them onto the cache root path.
